theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.scalar_fullTwist_eq_single_row {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
delta (scalarGenerators q hq) m ^ (m + 1) • 1 = q ^ Keystone.fullTwistLength (m + 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.scalar_isJMWeight {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
IsJMWeight (scalarGenerators q hq) 1 (jmEigen q (rowTableau m)) (m + 1)

def QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.rowTableau (m : ℕ) :
Fin (m + 1) ≃ { c : ℕ × ℕ // c ∈ Keystone.cells [m + 1] }

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.scalar_jmRaw {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
jmRaw (scalarGenerators q hq) k = q ^ (2 * k)

def QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.scalarGenerators {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
HeckeGenerators R R q

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.twist_scalar_eq_theta_sq {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {V : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup V] [Module A V] [Module R V] [IsScalarTower R A V] [NoZeroSMulDivisors R V] (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (hq : q ≠ 0) {l : MathlibExt.QPartitionCombinatorics.Partition} {m : ℕ} (e : Fin (m + 1) ≃ { c : ℕ × ℕ // c ∈ Keystone.cells l }) (v : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) (s : R) (hw : IsJMWeight H v (jmEigen q e) (m + 1)) (hs : delta H m ^ (m + 1) • v = s • v) :
s = Keystone.theta q l ^ 2

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.fullTwist_smul_eq_theta_sq {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {V : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup V] [Module A V] [Module R V] [IsScalarTower R A V] (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (hq : q ≠ 0) {l : MathlibExt.QPartitionCombinatorics.Partition} {m : ℕ} (e : Fin (m + 1) ≃ { c : ℕ × ℕ // c ∈ Keystone.cells l }) (v : V) (hw : IsJMWeight H v (jmEigen q e) (m + 1)) :
delta H m ^ (m + 1) • v = Keystone.theta q l ^ 2 • v

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.prod_jmEigen {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) {l : MathlibExt.QPartitionCombinatorics.Partition} {m : ℕ} (e : Fin (m + 1) ≃ { c : ℕ × ℕ // c ∈ Keystone.cells l }) :
∏ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), jmEigen q e k = Keystone.theta q l ^ 2

noncomputable def QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmEigen {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) {l : MathlibExt.QPartitionCombinatorics.Partition} {m : ℕ} (e : Fin (m + 1) ≃ { c : ℕ × ℕ // c ∈ Keystone.cells l }) :
ℕ → R

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.entryIdx_of_lt {m k : ℕ} (h : k < m + 1) :
entryIdx m k = ⟨k, h⟩

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.entryIdx_val (m : ℕ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
entryIdx m ↑i = i

def QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.entryIdx (m k : ℕ) :
Fin (m + 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.fullTwist_smul_of_weight {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {V : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup V] [Module A V] [Module R V] [IsScalarTower R A V] (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (v : V) (c : ℕ → R) (m : ℕ) (hw : IsJMWeight H v c (m + 1)) :
delta H m ^ (m + 1) • v = (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), c k) • v

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmProd_smul_of_weight {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {V : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup V] [Module A V] [Module R V] [IsScalarTower R A V] (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (v : V) (c : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
IsJMWeight H v c n → jmProd H n • v = (∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, c k) • v

def QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.IsJMWeight {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {V : Type u_3} [AddCommGroup V] [Module A V] [Module R V] (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (v : V) (c : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
Prop
